---

This file draws the causal diagrams. Don't render it directly; run `make-causal-figs.R`, which renders it and copies the figures to figs/ with descriptive names (the key is in that script).

This renders figures to causal_files/figure-html/. The copy chunk at the end moves them to figs/. Delete causal_files/ and causal_cache/ before rendering so stale files aren't copied.

Key (in order of the chunks below):

1. `fig-causal-overall`: Overall framework flowchart
2. `demand-pyramid.png` / `.pdf`: Demand space (latent, expressed, and fulfilled demands); written directly to figs/ by the R chunk
3. `fig-causal-demand`: Demand flowchart
4. `fig-causal-capacity`: Capacity flowchart
5. `fig-causal-strategy`: Strategy flowchart
6. `fig-causal-oldoverall`: Old combined figure (not used in the book)

Files are named either after the chunk label (e.g., fig-causal-demand-1.png) or as mermaid-figure-N.png, where N counts mermaid chunks only (1 = overall, 2 = demand, 3 = capacity, 4 = strategy, 5 = old combined). Check causal_files/figure-html after a clean render.




```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-causal-overall
%%| fig-cap: "How constituent demand, capacity, political environment, and Legislator's strategic choices shape interbranch representation activities"
%%| fig-width: 6.5
%%| out-width: "100%"

flowchart TD
        CD["Constituent<br/>Demand"]
        IR["Congressional Office Capacity"]
        G["Legislator Incentives"]
        W["Work Done by<br/>Congressional Office"]
        L["Legislation"]
        A["Interbranch Representation"]
        C["Communications"]

    CD --> W
    IR --> W
    G --> W
    W --> L
    W --> A
    W --> C


```


```{r}
#| label: make-demand-pyramid
#| include: false
tikz_src <- r"(\documentclass[tikz,border=5pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
% Inverted pyramid, apex at (0,0); halfwidth at height y is 0.75*y.
% Three bands: y = 6..4, 4..2, 2..0.
\definecolor{band1}{gray}{0.88}
\definecolor{band2}{gray}{0.69}
\definecolor{band3}{gray}{0.50}

\draw[fill=band1, draw=black, line width=1pt]
  (-4.5,6) -- (4.5,6) -- (3,4) -- (-3,4) -- cycle;
\draw[fill=band2, draw=black, line width=1pt]
  (-3,4) -- (3,4) -- (1.5,2) -- (-1.5,2) -- cycle;
\draw[fill=band3, draw=black, line width=1pt]
  (-1.5,2) -- (1.5,2) -- (0,0) -- cycle;

\node[font=\sffamily\bfseries] at (0,5)   {Latent Demands};
\node[font=\sffamily\bfseries] at (0,3)   {Expressed Demands};
\node[font=\sffamily\bfseries\footnotesize, align=center] at (0,1.45) {Fulfilled\\Demands};

\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document})"
writeLines(tikz_src, "figs/demand-pyramid.tex")
if (requireNamespace("tinytex", quietly = TRUE) && tinytex::is_tinytex()) {
  # TinyTeX: this auto-installs any missing LaTeX packages (e.g. standalone)
  tinytex::xelatex("figs/demand-pyramid.tex")
} else {
  xl <- Sys.which("xelatex")
  if (xl == "") xl <- "/Library/TeX/texbin/xelatex"  # MacTeX's home
  if (!file.exists(xl)) stop("Can't find xelatex from R.")
  system2(xl, c("-interaction=nonstopmode",
                "-output-directory=figs", "figs/demand-pyramid.tex"),
          stdout = FALSE)
}
if (!file.exists("figs/demand-pyramid.pdf"))
  stop("TikZ compile failed - see figs/demand-pyramid.log for the LaTeX error")
suppressWarnings(
  pdftools::pdf_convert("figs/demand-pyramid.pdf", format = "png",
                        dpi = 300, filenames = "figs/demand-pyramid.png")
)
```

![The demand pyramid: from latent to expressed to fulfilled demands](figs/demand-pyramid.pdf){#fig-demand-pyramid}

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-causal-capacity
%%| fig-cap: "How congressional office capacity shapes interbranch representation"
%%| fig-width: 6.5
%%| out-width: "100%"
%%{init: {"themeVariables": {"fontSize": "12px"}, "flowchart": {"subGraphTitleMargin": {"top": 10, "bottom": 10}, "htmlLabels": false}}}%%
flowchart LR
    D["Expressed demand<br/>(requests for help;<br/>Chapter 5)"]
    subgraph src ["Sources of capacity"]
        LE["Legislator<br/>experience"]
        ST["Staff quantity<br/>and experience"]
        CP["Committee<br/>leadership position"]
        RC["Reporting<br/>committee seat"]
    end
    O["Office's ability to<br/>act on demand and<br/>generate its own work"]
    W["Interbranch<br/>representation"]
    D ==> O
    LE --> O
    ST --> O
    CP --> O
    RC --> O
    O ==> W
    classDef demand fill:#f2f2f2,stroke:#888,stroke-dasharray: 4 3
    class D demand
```

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"themeVariables": {"fontSize": "12px"}, "flowchart": {"subGraphTitleMargin": {"top": 10, "bottom": 10}, "htmlLabels": false}}}%%
flowchart LR
    D["Expressed demand<br/>and office capacity<br/>(Chapters 5 and 6)"]

        EL["Electoral:<br/>competitive general<br/>and primary elections"]
        MJ["Institutional:<br/>majority status"]
    end
    O["Strategic choices:<br/>what activities, and<br/>on whose behalf"]
    SA["Staff<br/>allocation"]
    W["Interbranch<br/>representation"]
    D ==> O
    PI --> O
    EL --> O
    MJ --> O
    O --> SA
    SA --> W
    O ==> W
    classDef demand fill:#f2f2f2,stroke:#888,stroke-dasharray: 4 3
    class D demand
```

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-causal-oldoverall
%%| fig-cap: "Original Figure: How constituent demand, capacity, political environment, and Legislator's strategic choices shape interbranch representation activities"
%%| fig-width: 6.5
%%| out-width: "100%"

flowchart TD
    subgraph demand_g ["Demand"]
        CD["Constituent<br/>Demand"]
    end
    subgraph capacity_g ["Capacity"]
        IR["Institutional Resource<br/>Allocation"]
        SC["Legislator's Staff<br/>Capacity"]
        MK["Legislator's<br/>Experience"]
    end
    subgraph env_g ["Environment"]
        PE["Political<br/>Environment"]
    end
    subgraph strategic_g ["Strategic Incentives"]
        G["Legislator Incentives"]
        SA["Legislator's <br/> Staff Allocation"]
    end
    subgraph output_g ["Outputs"]
        W["Work Done by<br/>Congressional Office"]
        L["Legislation"]
        A["Interbranch Representation"]
        C["Communications"]
    end

    CD --> W
    PE --> G
    IR --> SC
    SC --> SA
    G --> W
    G -.-> SA
    MK --> W
    SA -.-> W
    W --> L
    W --> A
    W --> C
    C -.-> CD

    classDef output fill:#E69F00,stroke:#8A5F00,color:#1A1200;
    classDef demand fill:#56B4E9,stroke:#27607F,color:#04222F;
    classDef capacity fill:#009E73,stroke:#005A42,color:#00150F;
    classDef environment fill:#CC79A7,stroke:#7A4664,color:#2B0E1F;
    classDef strategic fill:#F0E442,stroke:#8A8020,color:#2B2800;
    class W,L,A,C output;
    class CD demand;
    class IR,SC,MK capacity;
    class PE environment;
    class G,SA strategic;

    style demand_g fill:#FBFBF9,stroke:#888780,color:#2C2C2A;
    style capacity_g fill:#FBFBF9,stroke:#888780,color:#2C2C2A;
    style env_g fill:#FBFBF9,stroke:#888780,color:#2C2C2A;
    style strategic_g fill:#FBFBF9,stroke:#888780,color:#2C2C2A;
    style output_g fill:#FBFBF9,stroke:#888780,color:#2C2C2A;
```

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"themeVariables": {"fontSize": "13px", "edgeLabelBackground": "#ffffff"}, "flowchart": {"htmlLabels": true, "curve": "basis"}}}%%
flowchart LR
    C["Constituent"]
    O["Member's office<br/>(caseworker)"]
    A["Federal agency"]
    C -->|"<b>1. Constituent request</b>"| O
  O ==>|"<b>2. Office contacts<br/>the agency</b><br/>(what we measure)"| A
    A -.->|"3. Agency responds<br/>(sometimes)"| O
    O -.->|"Office responds to<br/>the constituent<br/>(at any point)"| C
    linkStyle 1 stroke:#000,stroke-width:4px
    classDef default fill:#ffffff,stroke:#333
    classDef office fill:#e8e8e8,stroke:#333
    class O office
```


# copy to /figs/

```{r}
files <- list.files(
  "causal_files/figure-html",
  pattern = "\\.png$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

file.copy(files, "figs", overwrite = TRUE)
```
